summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a bought-deal offering of 6,000,000 Class A Preference Shares, Series 56 at C$25.00 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of C$150 million (C$200 million if the 2,000,000-share over-allotment is exercised), led by RBC, BMO, CIBC, National Bank, Scotiabank and TD. The shares carry a 5.65% cumulative quarterly fixed dividend to December 31, 2031, then reset every five years at the greater of the 5-year Government of Canada yield plus 2.15% or 5.65%. Net proceeds fund general corporate purposes; closing is expected on or about October 22, 2026. This is a routine Canadian shelf prospectus supplement takedown, not a special situation; watch only for pricing and over-allotment exercise.
